text.tspan: Plan
Review
vehicleAheadResponseValidationPlan
For NEED-DRIVING-008, a planned
stakeholder review. While the stationary
and the slower moving vehicle target
scenarios run (SC-DRIVING-012 and SC-
DRIVING-013), can verification engineers
and compliance engineers confirm, by the
criteria for a vehicle target that phase 5
derives, that the candidate requests the
warning and that its driving command
brakes the vehicle, and that no autopilot,
replay or overlay acts instead of the
candidate? Can they trace each of those
criteria to the provision of UNECE R152 it
is derived from, to the product-line
requirement it judges and whose obligation
it is, and name what the runs cannot show
of it? Can systems engineers and product-
line engineers confirm that every driving
command passed through Eclipse S-CORE to
the actuation and every warning request
through S-CORE to the AAOS SDV, and that
no other exchange carried them? And can
safety experts and product-line engineers
tell which element of the candidate gave
the braking command, whether it left the
candidate in the driving command or apart
from it, and whether that command keeps
the independence of the protected
emergency command path?
noReactionValidationPlan
For NEED-DRIVING-009, a planned
stakeholder review. While the vehicle
drives through the curve past the
stationary vehicle beyond the guard pipes
(SC-DRIVING-014), and while it follows the
vehicle ahead that turns off (SC-
DRIVING-015), can verification engineers
and compliance engineers confirm, by the
criterion that phase 5 states for each
scenario, that the candidate requests no
warning and commands no emergency braking,
and that the candidate's own driving
command moved the vehicle throughout each
run?
driverWarningValidationPlan
For NEED-DRIVING-010, a planned
stakeholder review. While the stationary
and the slower moving vehicle target
scenarios run (SC-DRIVING-012 and SC-
DRIVING-013), can safety experts and
verification engineers confirm that the
AAOS SDV gave each warning that the
candidate requested on its display and as
a sound, and when each mode began relative
to the warning request and to the start of
the emergency braking, with no recording
or overlay in place of either mode?
candidateIdentityValidationPlan
For NEED-DRIVING-011, a planned
stakeholder review. After each run of the
four scenarios (SC-DRIVING-012, SC-
DRIVING-013, SC-DRIVING-014 and SC-
DRIVING-015), can verification engineers
and product-line engineers bind its
verdict to the candidate revision and the
configuration that the run identifies, and
confirm that a build with a change that
upstream has not merged identifies itself
as a different candidate?
